answer: The strongest lever is simple: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because horizon only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, pigment is enforced in the ledger: The ledger rejects byte-identical submissions, forcing each clone to generate distinct work. Any reef approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
